evidence.claim: A SYSTEMATIC, CROSS-GATE HOLE: the CLI entry line itself - `if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())` - is asserted by nothing in 5 gates measured here. Replacing that `raise` with `pass` leaves every test green (the tests call main() directly) while `python <gate>.py` stops calling main() at all: the gate becomes a no-op that prints nothing and exits 0. That is precisely the failure rules/common/ci-hygiene.md section 1 exists to forbid, and the repo's own `# pragma: no cover - CLI entry` marker on those lines is what makes it invisible to the coverage gate as well.
